description: Source code implementing a QUIC connect tunnel for handling HTTP/2 CONNECT requests, establishing TCP connections, and relaying data between client and destination.

classes.name: ConnectTunnel
classes.description: Manages a QUIC tunnel for HTTP/2 CONNECT requests, handling connection setup, data relay, and stream termination.

methods.name: OpenTunnel
methods.description: Initiates a tunnel based on request headers, validates authority, establishes TCP connection, and responds to client.

methods.name: IsConnectedToDestination
methods.description: Checks if the tunnel is currently connected to the destination server.

methods.name: SendDataToDestination
methods.description: Sends data to the destination server through the established TCP socket.

methods.name: OnClientStreamClose
methods.description: Handles closure of the client stream, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ConnectComplete
methods.description: Callback for completion of connection attempt (not expected to be called asynchronously).

methods.name: ReceiveComplete
methods.description: Handles data received from the destination server and forwards it to the client.

methods.name: SendComplete
methods.description: Callback for completion of data send (not expected to be called asynchronously).

methods.name: BeginAsyncReadFromDestination
methods.description: Starts asynchronous read operation from the destination socket.

methods.name: OnDestinationConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles closure of the destination connection, cleaning up resources and closing the client stream.

methods.name: SendConnectResponse
methods.description: Sends a 200 OK response to establish the CONNECT tunnel.

methods.name: TerminateClientStream
methods.description: Terminates the client stream with an error, providing a reason.
